No T&P shall have issued by the department.

Unserviceable dismantle material received from the work shall credited to the contractor.

sections.heading: List of Documents to be scanned and uploaded within the period of bid submission:

items.text: Treasury Challan / Demand Draft / Pay order or Banker's Cheque/Deposit at Call Receipt/FDR of any scheduled Bank against EMD in favour of Executive Engineer (E), ED-XVII, CPWD, New Delhi.
Copy of receipt for deposition of original EMD issued from Division office of any Executive Engineer, CPWD (In Enclosed Performa)
Enlistment Order of the Contractor of the composite category in CPWD in appropriate category.

Other experienced contractors/ specialized agency/ Firm who deals in works of "Repairing or Edward make Fire alarm system" Along with the similar work's experience as mentioned at S.No.1 (B) in the eligibility criteria along with following documents: -

i.) Average annual financial turn over should be at least 50% of the estimated cost during the immediate last three financial year ending 31st march 2025. (Scanned copy of certificate from C.A. to be uploaded) ii) Should not have incurred any loss in more than two years during the last five years ending 31st March,2025. (Scanned copy of certificate from C.A. to be uploaded) iii) Should have a solvency of 40% of the estimated cost or submit net worth certificate of minimum 15% of ECPT issued by the certificate Chartered Accountant (on the format prescribed in form 'B'/FormB-1) (Scanned copy of original Solvency or Net Worth Certificate from C.A. to be uploaded)

GST registration certificate, if already obtained by the bidder. lf the bidder has not obtained GST registration as applicable, then he shall scan and upload following undertaking lf work is awarded to me, l/we shall obtain GST registration certificate, as applicable, within one month from the date of receipt of award letter or before release of any Payment by CPWD, whichever is earlier, failing which l/we shall be responsible for any delay in payments which will be due towards me/us on account of the work executed and/or for any action taken by CPWD or GST department in this regard.

Valid Electrical Contractor License or undertaking that they will either obtain valid electrical license at the time of execution of electrical work or associate the contractor having valid electrical license of appropriate class.
Email & mobile no. of the firm/ agency on the letter head of firm/ agency (For making correspondence).

notes: Note: The Lowest Bidder is required to produce original document on or before or at the time of submission of Performance guarantee Money which are uploaded by the bidder at the time of bid submission otherwise Performance guarantee Money shall not be accepted and EMD shall be forfeited.
